summary_en: This work develops a spatiospectral photoacoustic microscopy platform based on stable, wavelength-tunable dual-pulse excitation from a gain-switched Ti:sapphire laser. The source and acquisition design are intended to improve the accuracy of spectrally resolved molecular-dynamics imaging. Because the paper's main contribution is photoacoustic image acquisition and system design, it is a core addition to the repository.
